Balance Druid

Arcane and Nature caster with the new EclipseEclipseTalentCastInstant mechanic — WrathWrathLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost10 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 15 Nature damage to the target. shortens your next StarfireStarfireLevel 20 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 7Cast3.5 sec castCost95 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 81 Arcane damage to the target., so you alternate rather than spam one spell.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Balance build has been tested. Moonkin FormMoonkin FormLevel 40 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantDurationUntil cancelledShapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party members within 45 yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects. is the 31-point capstone, which means level 40 — nobody in the beta has ever been in it, at any cap. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended. Blizzard's own caveat: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Balance is for

Damage from outside melee, on a rotation that alternates instead of spamming one spell: Nature's ReachNature's ReachTalentCastInstantIncreases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%. 2/2 extends the range of all your damaging spells and raises your hit chance on top, EclipseEclipseTalentCastInstant makes WrathWrathLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost10 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 15 Nature damage to the target. cut the cast time of your next 2 StarfireStarfireLevel 20 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 7Cast3.5 sec castCost95 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 81 Arcane damage to the target.s with no crit required, and Entangling RootsEntangling RootsLevel 8 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 sec holds up to 3 targets with OvergrowthOvergrowthTalentCastInstantIncreases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 2. and is no longer outdoors-only.

The published verdict, which measures solo kill speed: "Balance Druid is an ok levelling choice. It does have a bit more downtime than Feral Druid would, but the larger range on your abilities can make tagging mobs much easier… Expect to start out very slowly though."

That verdict predates a significant buff. On September 24, in Blizzard’s own words, "Wrath base damage increased ~50%". On top of that Improved WrathImproved WrathTalentCastInstantReduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.1 sec and its Mana cost by 50%. 5/5 now also cuts Wrath’s mana cost, and MoonglowMoonglowTalent · Rank 1CastInstantReduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by 25%. 3/3 cuts the mana cost of all damaging spells where Classic’s cut a named list with heals included — both directions are Blizzard’s, but the figures the guide sites quote (50%, 25%, against Classic’s 9%) are client readings, not published. Restoration loses a mana talent in the trade. Balance's levelling case is stronger than the published guides read — that is our own reading of the buff, and no source has revisited its verdict since.

Rotation

The honest version: at these levels it is short.

  1. Apply and maintain MoonfireMoonfireLevel 4 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration9 secBurns the enemy for 8 Arcane damage and then an additional 12 Arcane damage over 9 sec.
  2. Maintain Insect SwarmInsect SwarmLevel 20 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secThe enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 48 Nature damage over 12 sec. if you have it, it is a tier-4 Balance talent, so level 25 at the earliest
  3. Spam WrathWrathLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost10 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 15 Nature damage to the target.

Stat priority

Item level, then Spell Power, Intellect, Haste, critical strike, Spirit.

"Focus on equipping your highest level pieces" while levelling. More specifically: Arcane damage for MoonfireMoonfireLevel 4 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 10CastInstantCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration9 secBurns the enemy for 8 Arcane damage and then an additional 12 Arcane damage over 9 sec. and StarfireStarfireLevel 20 · Spell · Arcane · Rank 1 of 7Cast3.5 sec castCost95 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 81 Arcane damage to the target., with plain Spell Power worth the same, and Nature damage good for WrathWrathLevel 1 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost10 ManaRange30 yd rangeCauses 15 Nature damage to the target. alone. Then Intellect. Between two otherwise equal pieces the leather one wins, for the armour. Stamina sits near the bottom.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
